explanation: Kourovka 1.40: is a group that is the product of two normal nilsubgroups (Engel subgroups) itself a nilgroup? A nilgroup is a group all of whose elements are Engel, with no boundedness. Since H and K are normal, the product is the join. Left- and right-Engel conventions agree for "every element is Engel". The notebook (v50) lists the problem with no answer. The statement is faithful and open.
